entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Kuchinda P.S. Case No.7 of 2021 corresponding to S.T. Case No.21 of 2021 pending in the Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge, Kuchinda for offences punishable under sections 376-D/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge, Kuchinda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge, Kuchinda vide order dated 08.08.2022.

Learned counsel for the petitioner referring to the evidence of the victim (P.W.2) submitted that she has implicated not only the petitioner but also the co- accused Hagru @ Benudhar Kisan in the commission of rape on her, but the said co-accused has already been released on bail by this Court in BLAPL No.4336 of 2021 as per order dated 23.07.2021 and therefore, the bail application of the petitioner may be favourably considered.

Learned counsel filed the deposition copy of P.W.2, which Dileswar Kisan vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51090167/
1 is taken on record.

entities.text: Dileswar Kisan vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
When the bail application was moved in BLAPL No.4336 of 2021, the same was disposed of on 23.07.2021 mainly basing on the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim and since the victim only identified the petitioner as the culprit and further stated that she could not identify the other co-accused and no test identification parade has been conducted in respect of co-accused Hagru @
Benudhar Kisan, his bail application was allowed.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that he has instruction that all the witnesses have already been examined by the prosecution.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parities and since it is a case of gang rape, while not inclining to release the petitioner on bail on merit, but taking into account the period of detention of the petitioner in judicial custody, I direct learned trial Court to expedite the trial and conclude the same within a period of three months from the date of receipt of the order.
The petitioner is at liberty to renew his prayer for bail, if the trial is not concluded within the said period.
The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
A copy of the order be communicated to the learned trial Court for compliance.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge sipun Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Date: 15-Jul-2024 12:07:20
